plus.analyst_notes:
Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/22671
Coded from the Hacking-ext-unknown template (issue tag) with deviations: TechCabal (Nov 12, 2025), citing CarePay's internal status report to insurers, says attackers compromised a third-party healthcare provider's device, stole its user credentials and used them to access the M-TIBA Version 2 platform. So hacking variety is Use of stolen creds and vector Partner (credentials of a provider using the platform), not Unknown/Web application. The provider's own device is not coded as a victim asset (it belongs to the partner); malware on it is not stated. Platform asset coded S - Unknown because sources do not say which server/app component was accessed.
Actor: 'Kazu' claimed the breach, posting a ~2GB sample on its Telegram channel and advertising the 2.15 TB database on darkforums (HapaKenya, TechEconomy). Kazu is a recently emerged data-theft/extortion gang (GovInfoSecurity) -> Organized crime, motive Financial (database advertised). No ransom demand to CarePay is documented, so no action.social Extortion was coded. Actor country unknown.
Victim: CarePay Ltd, Nairobi, operator of the Safaricom-backed M-TIBA health wallet/claims platform. Industry 524 from the issue NAICS line (524292 third-party administration of insurance funds may fit better). Employees: Growjo estimates ~443 -> 101 to 1000 (estimate).
Timeline: intrusion Oct 17-25, 2025; CarePay discovered it Oct 27, 2025 (10 days), the same day the actor's post was publicized -> discovery external Actor disclosure (reviewer may prefer unknown; TechCabal does not say how CarePay learned of it). dbir_year 2026. security_incident Confirmed based on CarePay's internal report per TechCabal; CarePay initially neither confirmed nor denied.
Data: names, national ID numbers, photos, phone contacts, DOB, diagnoses, lab results, prescriptions, discharge summaries, insurance claims and benefit data (Personal, Medical). data_total 4,800,000 = CarePay report figure for beneficiary and claims records (also the actor's claim); the leaked sample covered ~114,000 users. data_abuse 'Yes - Posted on personal forum' because a sample was publicly posted on the actor's Telegram channel/forum. Hosting not stated -> cloud Unknown. ODPC opened an investigation.
Issue data problem: the issue's Source link (dawan.africa) now returns 'Article Not Found'; kept in references as the issue-linked source, facts corroborated by TechCabal and HapaKenya.

event_chain.summary: Use of stolen creds: partner provider credentials used to access M-TIBA platform
Data copied; sample posted and database advertised by Kazu

summary: Attackers stole the credentials of a third-party healthcare provider using the M-TIBA platform, operated by Kenya's CarePay and backed by Safaricom, and used them to access the M-TIBA Version 2 platform between October 17 and 25, 2025. A group calling itself Kazu claimed the theft of 2.15 TB of data, advertised the database on a cybercrime forum and posted a 2GB sample with names, national ID numbers, contacts, diagnoses and billing records. CarePay discovered the breach on October 27, 2025; about 4.8 million beneficiary and claims records were affected and Kenya's data protection regulator opened an investigation.
